system.description: As an initiate of the Omnissiah's priesthood you receive these implants: an Electro-Graft (interface with machine ports and some data nets), Electoo Inductors (emit or draw power), a Respirator Unit (+1k1 against gas weapons and toxins carried in the air, plus a vox-synthesizer), a Cyber-Mantle (anchor for later implants) and a Potentia Coil (stores energy and projects fields).
